seo_title: Frnds — pizzeria and breakfast in Esil district
seo_description: Frnds in Astana's Esil district: 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, left bank. Open every day from 09:00 to 23:00, and we cook breakfast all day long.
h1: We're in the Esil district — come by like a neighbour
body:
Frnds is at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. That's the left bank, Esil district — an ordinary residential block, not a storefront in a shopping centre. We have no second address and aren't planning one: everything that happens at Frnds happens here. We open at nine in the morning and close at eleven at night, every day, no days off. We know this neighbourhood through its people rather than its map — the ones who keep turning up: whoever stops in on the way to work, whoever comes back in the evening, whoever wanders in off a walk because it's closer than going home and out again.

It's easy here if you live in the buildings nearby. You can come as you are, straight from home, with no plan for the evening. Easy too if you work close by: lunch, coffee with a laptop, the kind of conversation you'd rather not book a meeting room for. Weekends bring prams, and for us that's an ordinary morning, not a rare occasion. Eat in the dining room or take it with you — pick up a cup, keep walking, nobody will talk you into sitting down.

The day here has a steady shape. Mornings are quiet: coffee to go, breakfast by the window, someone finishing whatever's on their own screen. Breakfast doesn't stop at noon, though — we cook it the whole time we're open. Come right at opening or come after a shift when it's already dark outside, and you'll still get a morning plate. Closer to midday it gets louder: pizza, pasta, soup, an hour-long meeting squeezed between other things. In the evening the room settles in for a while — groups, families, two people after work. On 2GIS we have 4.

If you live or work in the Esil district and have been walking past our windows all this time, consider us finally introduced. You don't need an occasion to come. Breakfast in the morning, a slice of pizza in the afternoon, tea before closing — all equally good reasons to open the door. The easiest way to find us is the sign; the easiest way to reach us is Instagram @frnds.kz or WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15. We're here from nine in the morning until eleven at night, and it's far better in here when it's neighbours at the tables.
landmarks: We're at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street — the left bank, the residential part of the Esil district, among courtyards and offices. There's one landmark: the Frnds sign. Once you've spotted it, you can stop looking.
cta: Come by without a reason — breakfast here will wait for you, even late in the evening.
